mapper.select: SELECT parent_id,status FROM category WHERE category_id=#{categoryId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(c.category_id AS CHAR) AS categoryId,c.category_name AS categoryName,CAST(c.parent_id AS CHAR) AS parentId,c.sort_order AS sortOrder,c.description,c.status,CAST(c.version AS CHAR) AS version,CAST(c.migrated_to AS CHAR) AS migratedTo,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM article_info a WHERE a.category_id=c.category_id AND a.deleted=0) AS articleCount FROM category c ORDER BY c.parent_id,c.sort_order,c.category_id
